 Liga MX Picks
 Pachuca sits in fourteenth place, four points out of the last Liga MX playoff spot; a loss against Cruz Azul at home in Matchday 13 would practically guarantee their elimination. A great match is expected at Estadio Miguel Hidalgo, and the pre-match odds are quite even.
 The incredible thing about Pachuca being so low in the standings is that they are completely failing to capitalize on another outstanding season from veteran Venezuelan striker Salomón Rondón. The gladiator scored again, bringing his tally to 13 goals, five more than the player who trails him in that category. Pachuca has not only failed to win any of its last four matches but also conceded the first goal in each of them.
 Cruz Azul, after two chaotic 3-3 draws, first against Toluca and then against Pumas, finally delivered a resounding victory, thrashing Juárez 5-0 in Matchday 12. It was one of those nights when Huiqui's team looked cohesive, so much so that the goals came from five different players.
